bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
cid=gace-createvdobot-videobot-poll-1
src=/home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/create-videobot
test "$(docker inspect "$cid" --format '{{.State.Running}}')" = true || exit 61
test "$(docker ps --filter label=com.docker.compose.project=gace-createvdobot --filter label=com.docker.compose.service=videobot-poll -q | wc -l)" -eq 1 || exit 62
expected="$(git -C "$src" show "70b754a647b097c28243168565f0ed4906087f9f:src/telegram/stickerSales.mjs" | sha256sum | cut -d' ' -f1)" || exit 63
live="$(docker exec "$cid" sha256sum /opt/videobot/src/telegram/stickerSales.mjs | cut -d' ' -f1)" || exit 64
test "$expected" = "$live" || exit 65
docker exec "$cid" grep -Fq "[b('同意して購入へ','sale:accept')]" /opt/videobot/src/telegram/stickerSales.mjs || exit 66
docker exec "$cid" grep -Fq "stickerLandingPanel" /opt/videobot/src/telegram/stickerSales.mjs || exit 67
docker exec "$cid" grep -Fq '✅ 登録できました！' /opt/videobot/src/telegram/stickerWizard.mjs || exit 68
docker logs --tail 150 "$cid" 2>&1 | grep -Fq 'CREATOR_DM_POLL_READY=PASS' || exit 69
shop="$(docker inspect "$cid" --format '{{range .Config.Env}}{{println .}}{{end}}' | sed -n 's/^VIDEOBOT_SHOP_PUBLIC_URL=//p' | head -n1)"
case "$shop" in https://shop.hentaigay.org|https://shop.hentaigay.org/) shopflag=CONFIGURED ;; '') shopflag=UNCONFIGURED ;; *) shopflag=OTHER_CONFIGURED ;; esac
printf 'CREATEVDOBOT_SALE_RUNTIME_READBACK=PASS\nSOURCE_SHA=%s\nLIVE_FILE_SHA256=%s\nSINGLE_POLL=PASS\nOFFER_CONSENT=ACTIVE\nSTICKER_RETURN=ACTIVE\nREGISTRATION_SUCCESS_UI=ACTIVE\nSHOP_URL=%s\n' "70b754a647b097c28243168565f0ed4906087f9f" "$live" "$shopflag"
